• 1 Gift of Fortune}} | type = Greatsword | level = 80 | rarity = exotic | collection = Legendary Weapon: Twilight | prefix = berserker | uslot = Superior Sigil of Rage | bound = use | salvage = none | skin = Dusk (skin); Naegling (skin); Dusk Experiment (skin) | set = Precursor weapons | id = 29185 }} [[Dusk]] is an [[exotic]] level 80 [[greatsword]] and the [[precursor weapon]] for [[Twilight]]. == Acquisition == === Recipe === * Crafted once per account after completing the [[Twilight III: Dusk]] collection. {{recipe | source = recipe sheet | sheet = Box of Recipes: Dusk | type = Legendary Component | disciplines = Weaponsmith | rating = 500 | ingredient1 = 1 Essence of Gloom | ingredient2 = 1 Spirit of the Perfected Nightsword | ingredient3 = 1 Mirror (item) | ingredient4 = 1 Dimensional Destabilizer | id = 11180 }} === Contained in === {{contained in}} === Other === {{exotic weapon text}} == Used in == {{Recipe list}} == Trivia == * Before the [[Heart of Thorns]] release, this sword shared its skin with the [[Naegling]] greatsword. * A [[Bringer's Wrapped Greatsword|"gift-wrapped" version]] of this skin can be found as part of the [[Wrapped weapons]] set.
